title: Technical Trainer
description:
**Company Description**
Brillare Science Limited is a personal care company committed to delivering real solutions for hair and skin concerns rather than marketing-driven promises. The company focuses on 100% natural, super-potent ingredients designed to provide visible and reliable results. Brillare challenges conventional cosmetic industry practices by prioritizing efficacy, transparency, and ingredient integrity. Applicants joining Brillare will be part of a mission-driven team that aims to build trust through products that genuinely perform and packaging that clearly communicates what is inside.
  
**Role Description**
The Technical Trainer role at Brillare Science Limited is a full-time, on-site position based in Chennai. The Technical Trainer will design, deliver, and update training programs on Brillare’s products, ingredients, and technical concepts for internal teams, retail partners, and other stakeholders. Daily responsibilities include conducting classroom and hands-on training sessions, preparing training materials and manuals, and translating complex technical information into clear, practical guidance. The role also involves assessing training effectiveness, maintaining training records, and coordinating with product, sales, and marketing teams to ensure accurate and consistent technical messaging. The Technical Trainer will support continuous learning by organizing refresher trainings, responding to technical queries, and staying current with industry developments and Brillare’s product innovations.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Experience in Technical Training and Technical Trainer roles, with the ability to explain complex concepts in an accessible way.
* Skills in Training & Development and Training, including program design, delivery, and evaluation.
* Strong Communication skills for presenting, facilitating group sessions, and engaging diverse audiences.
* Background in cosmetics, personal care, or related science (e.g., chemistry, cosmetology, dermatology) is preferred.
* Ability to create clear training materials, presentations, and documentation using standard office and digital tools.
* Proven organizational and time-management skills, with attention to detail and follow-through.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience in training or technical education.
* Comfort working on-site in Chennai and collaborating cross-functionally with product, sales, and marketing teams.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
**Orchestrate Professional Services Success as a Project Coordinator**
Are you high-energy, flexible, and exceptionally detail-oriented? Do you have a passion for delighting customers, building strong cross-functional relationships, and maintaining a solid understanding of enterprise software offerings? Trimble is seeking a dedicated Project Coordinator to join our Construction Management Solutions (CMS) division in Chennai. In this vital role, you will manage project setup, oversee resource requests, and keep our system of record current, acting as a crucial operational anchor for our Professional Services organization.
  
  
**About Us**
Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB),
  
  
visit: www.trimble.com
  
  
**About Our Construction Management Solutions Division:**
CMS delivers compelling capability and connected workflows that enhance the profitability of our customers and drive business growth. We provide immense value to clients through our suite of leading products on Trimble Construction One (TC1), supported by world-class engineering, marketing, and professional services.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Great**
Operating out of our Chennai office on a night-shift schedule to support our US-based teams, you will serve as a central operational liaison across Professional Services Managers, Resource Managers, and Project Managers. You will enjoy complete ownership over project administration, data integrity, and internal communication tools, while collaborating cross-functionally whenever client needs span across business units. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love bringing order to complex schedules, this position offers an ideal platform to sharpen your project management expertise inside a global technology leader.
  
  
Key Exciting Responsibilities
  
  

* Project Setup & System Maintenance: Own the administration of project setups, ongoing consulting requests, and project maintenance within our enterprise system of record, ensuring all data remains accurate and up-to-date.
* Customer Inquiry & Request Management: Act as a primary point of contact for ongoing customer inquiries within Professional Services, directing cross-functional collaboration when customer needs extend beyond the division.
* Resource & PM Collaboration: Partner closely with Professional Services Managers, Resource Managers, and Project Managers to collect key project metrics, track deliverables, and manage tight operational timelines.
* Internal Communication Management: Maintain, organize, and improve internal team communication repositories and knowledge bases (including Google Sites and Google Drive).
* Process Optimization & Problem Solving: Identify existing or potential operational bottlenecks, propose thoughtful data-driven solutions, and continuously refine internal project tracking workflows.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Education & Experience: University degree in Business Administration or a related discipline, combined with a minimum of two years of experience coordinating projects (or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience).
* Project Coordination & Methodologies: Basic knowledge of project management practices and proven experience coordinating project activities within a matrixed corporate environment.
* Deadline & Pressure Resilience: Demonstrated ability to complete deadline-driven assignments consistently, accommodate urgent requests, and remain productive under pressure while balancing competing priorities.
* Communication Excellence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain information clearly, listen effectively, and present data accurately across business units.
* Analytical Problem Solving: Self-motivated mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities, high accountability, and a drive to pursue ongoing learning opportunities.

**Bonus Points For**

* Tooling Proficiency: Hands-on experience using Google Workspace, Salesforce, Kantata (formerly Mavenlink), and Smartsheet.
* Methodology Training: Professional coursework, certifications, or formal training in project management methodologies.
* Financial & Industry Context: Basic understanding of accounting principles/terminology and structural familiarity with the construction industry landscape.
* Technical Aptitude: Tech-oriented mindset with comfort in learning and adapting to new enterprise software technologies rapidly.

**Logistics**

* Location: Chennai, India (In-office position)
* Work Schedule: Night-shift schedule.
* Job Type: Full-Time.

Why You'll Love Working With Us
  
  
At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
  
  

* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.

****How to Apply:****
Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.
  
  
**Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**
At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

title: vehicle diagnostics
description:
A typical
**Vehicle Diagnostics Engineer**
role at
**Renault Nissan Technology & Business Centre India (RNTBCI)**
focuses on developing and validating vehicle diagnostic functions compliant with automotive standards.
  
  
Job Title
  
  
**Vehicle Diagnostics Engineer**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop and maintain vehicle diagnostic specifications for ECUs.
* Define and validate diagnostic functions based on UDS (ISO 14229) and OBD-II requirements.
* Configure and test Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs), Diagnostic Identifiers (DIDs), and Routine Control services.
* Analyze CAN/LIN communication and troubleshoot diagnostic issues.
* Work with software, calibration, validation, and ECU suppliers to resolve diagnostic defects.
* Perform diagnostic validation using tools such as CANoe, CANalyzer, or DDT2000.
* Support software integration, vehicle testing, and issue analysis.
* Ensure compliance with Renault-Nissan diagnostic standards and regulatory requirements.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, diagnostic specifications, and test reports.
* Participate in defect tracking and root cause analysis.

Required Skills
  
  

* Knowledge of automotive communication protocols:

+ CAN
+ LIN
+ Ethernet (preferred)

* Understanding of:

+ UDS (ISO 14229)
+ OBD-II
+ ISO 15765 (CAN Transport Protocol)

* Experience with tools such as:

+ Vector CANoe
+ CANalyzer
+ DDT2000
+ INCA (preferred)

* Understanding of ECU architecture and embedded systems.
* Familiarity with diagnostics over CAN and vehicle networks.
* Basic scripting knowledge (CAPL or Python) is an advantage.
* Strong debugging and analytical skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Automobile, or related disciplines.
* Typically 2–6 years of experience in automotive diagnostics, ECU validation, or embedded systems.

Common Interview Topics
  
  

* UDS services (0x10, 0x11, 0x19, 0x22, 0x27, 0x2E, 0x31, 0x34, 0x36, 0x37).
* DTC lifecycle and fault memory.
* OBD-II requirements and emission-related diagnostics.
* CAN protocol, CAN frames, arbitration, and message IDs.
* Diagnostic session control and security access.
* Flash programming and bootloader concepts.
* CAPL scripting basics.
* ECU communication and diagnostic troubleshooting.
* Difference between functional and physical addressing.
* Positive and negative response codes in UDS.

This role is suited to engineers with backgrounds in
**automotive electronics, ECU diagnostics, embedded systems, or vehicle network validation**
, rather than mechanical design.
  
  
SEGULA Technologies is a global engineering group, boosting the competitiveness of all major industrial sectors: automotive, aerospace, energy, rail, naval, life sciences, and telecoms. With a presence in more than 30 countries and 140 locations worldwide, the Group prioritizes close relationships with its clients, driven by the expertise of its 15,000 employees. As a leading engineering player putting innovation at the heart of its strategy, SEGULA Technologies manages large-scale projects, ranging from initial studies to industrialization and production. SEGULA TECHNOLOGIES is dedicated to gender balance and diversity, recognizing and recruiting talent of all backgrounds.

title: Team Member - Green Steel
description:
**As a strategic step towards Sustainability:**
JSW Steel has established a Steel Recycling Business to cater the growing scrap demand. As part of this initiative, the state-of-the-art Scrap Processing Facility of ~0.5 MTPA is planned in the vicinity of Chennai. This plant encompassing shredding & baling operations to ensure high-quality scrap supply to the plant in the vicinity of Chennai.
  
  
**Strengthening the Scrap Supply Chain:**
To further secure and enhance scrap availability, it is imperative to establish collection and processing centres across strategic locations.
  
  
**Role Scope & Key Deliverables**

* The role covers the entire value chain - from conducting comprehensive market studies and building the business case to securing requisite approvals, driving plant setup, and managing operations thereafter.

This includes in-depth market analysis, strong technical knowledge, project management skills, and coordination with vendors, contractors, and internal stake holders.
  
  
**Key Result Areas (Key Performance Indicators)**

* Analyze market for scrap types, supply-demand dynamics, pricing trends, and regulatory changes in the Domestic & International Market
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard partners (yards, aggregators, dismantlers, OEMs, logistics) for obsolete and prompt scrap.
* Identifying required technologies & infrastructure, Prepare capex, business case, board notes, and evaluate land/locations for setting up scrap processing centres.
* Plan and execute projects according to approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality standards.
* Supervise installation, testing, and commissioning activities.
* Identify project risks, delays, and technical problems and implement corrective actions.

**Critical Tasks**

* Developing Business Framework for setting up Scrap Collection & Processing Centres.
* Identifying the required technology & infrastructure for the processing units such as equipment, land & plant infra, etc
* Ensure equipment selection and design comply with project specifications and applicable engineering standards
* Prepare technical specifications, RFQs, BOQs, and equipment datasheets
* Prepare technical evaluation of mechanical equipment and vendor offers
* Ensure execution is in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and quality requirements.
* Coordinate day-to-day site activities with civil, electrical, instrumentation, and other disciplines
* Carryout commissioning, trial runs, and performance testing of mechanical systems
* Monitor project progress and identify delays, technical risks, and interface issues and initiate corrective actions
* Take over the plant for operation post commissioning

**Educational Background And Work Experience**

* Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering
* 5+ years of working in Project Execution and Supply chain

**Competencies**

* Experience in business development, sales, or supply chain roles within the steel, scrap, recycling, or waste management industry
* Knowledge of local and international scrap market regulations and compliance.
* Project planning and execution
* Site supervision
* Vendor/contractor management
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, SAP etc

title: Quantum Computing Associate

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**About Us**

Effy (Rayles and Roobie Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) is a Chennai-based custom software development company and Freshworks Premium System Integration Partner, building integrations, middleware/APIs, and marketplace apps for clients across fintech, retail, media, and legal sectors. This role owns quality assurance across all client integrations and Freshworks marketplace apps and also acts as the technical point of contact for support requests raised by clients, customers, and partners making this a hybrid QA and technical support/customer success role.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a customer-focused and technically inclined Technical Support Engineer to join our team. This role is ideal for freshers and candidates with up to 2 years of experience who have good communication skills, an interest in troubleshooting technical issues, and a willingness to learn.

You will be responsible for handling customer support tickets, participating in customer calls, performing initial debugging, and providing timely responses to customer queries. As we work with customers across the UK and US, strong English communication skills are essential.

Knowledge transfer and guidance will be provided to help you understand our applications and handle customer issues independently.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Handle customer support tickets, investigate reported issues, and provide timely responses and updates.
* Attend customer calls and communicate professionally with customers across the UK and US.
* Perform L1 troubleshooting and initial debugging of application-related issues.
* Test APIs using tools such as Postman and validate API requests and responses.
* Use Browser Developer Tools to inspect network requests, analyze console errors, and troubleshoot application issues.
* Explain technical issues and troubleshooting steps clearly to both technical and non-technical customers.
* Document investigation findings, error messages, logs, and troubleshooting steps in support tickets.
* Escalate complex issues to the development team with relevant technical details.
* Follow up on open tickets and coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Learn our products and applications through internal knowledge-transfer sessions and apply the knowledge to customer support activities.

**Required Skills:**

* Good verbal and written English communication skills.
* Confidence in communicating with international customers.
* Basic understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, status codes, and JSON.
* Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman.
* Basic knowledge of Browser Developer Tools, especially Console and Network tabs.
* Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand technical problems and explain them in simple terms.
* Good documentation, ticket management, and follow-up skills.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Basic knowledge of JavaScript or any scripting knowledge.
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and web applications.
* Understanding of client-server architecture and API integrations.
* Internship, academic project, or prior experience in technical support or application support is an added advantage.

**Additional Preferred Skills - AI Tools**

* Basic familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT (GPT), Claude or Cursor etc.
* Ability to use AI tools to assist with technical troubleshooting, error analysis, understanding API responses, and identifying potential solutions.
* Willingness to learn and leverage AI-powered tools to improve productivity and problem-solving efficiency.
* Basic understanding of how to use AI tools to analyze code snippets, browser console errors, and technical documentation.



**Who Can Apply?**

* Freshers and candidates with
  **0–2 years of experience**
  .
* Candidates interested in technical support, application troubleshooting, and API testing.
* Individuals with strong communication skills and a willingness to learn new technologies.

If you enjoy solving problems, helping customers, and working with technology, we'd love to hear from you!

* Run onboarding sessions, product trainings, and walkthroughs for HR teams, sub-admins, managers, and employee champions.
* Guide customers on survey best practices, participation strategy, question design, anonymity, reporting, and action planning.
* Handle technical setup like employee data uploads, CSV and Excel files, custom configurations, integrations, access rules, and reporting requirements.
* Work with the People Science team to deliver reports and insights that match the customer’s real context.
* Partner closely with CSMs to flag adoption risks, unblock customers, spot expansion opportunities, and keep the account journey smooth.
* Raise and track Jira tickets for bugs, backend tasks, feature requests, and product gaps.
* Become the internal voice of the customer for Product and Engineering.
* Run roadmap and product update conversations with customers so they always know what is possible and what is coming next.
* Most importantly, make sure the customer does not just “run a survey”...
* Make sure they actually understand what their people are saying.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Implementation, Customer Service, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
* Someone who can learn a product deeply and explain it simply.
* Someone who is comfortable working with HRIS data, employee data files, CSVs, Excel, user attributes, reporting structures, and basic integration concepts.
* A clear communicator who can run a training session with an HR team and also explain technical details to an IT stakeholder.
* Strong project management habits. You follow up, track open items, document clearly, and keep multiple accounts moving without being chased.
* A consulting mindset. You ask good questions before giving answers. You can push back kindly when a customer’s approach may not help them.
* A strong eye for detail. Survey setup, data mapping, anonymity rules, access control, and reporting logic need precision.
* A collaborative nature. You will work closely with CSMs, People Science, Product, and Engineering.Comfort with flexible shifts that overlap with US time zones, because our customers are spread across geographies.

**THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE HOPING TO MEET**

* Someone who can bring calm to complexity.
* Someone who can sit with an HR leader, understand their culture problem, and translate it into a clean survey journey.
* Someone who can tell a customer, “Here's a better way to do this,” with both confidence and kindness.
* Someone who wants to build, not just maintain.
* Someone who believes customer success is not only about renewals...
* It is about making customers feel, “these people really understand us.”

If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

title: Engineer II, Supplier Quality
description:
**Description**
Enphase Energy is a global energy technology company and a leading provider of solar, battery, and electric vehicle charging products. Founded in 2006, our innovative microinverter technology revolutionized solar power, making it a safer, more reliable, and scalable energy source. Today, the Enphase Energy System enables users to make, use, save, and sell their own power. Enphase is also one of the most successful and innovative clean energy companies in the world, with more than 80 million products shipped across 160 countries.
  
  
Join our dynamic teams designing and developing next-gen energy technologies and help drive a sustainable future!
  
  
**Must be available to work on-site at Salcomp, Chennai, India 5 days per week.**
**About The Role**

* APQP/PPAP Administration: Manage the submission and review process of Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) documents.
* Systemic Solutions Support: Act as a key contributor and System Administrator for the deployment of new electronic tools for supplier quality management.
* Supplier Data compliance: Audit suppliers supporting quality documents to ensure they meet Enphase requirements before final SQE approval.

+ Ensure that all suppliers have completed the qualification steps before releasing them to production by developing dashboard to help SQEs track suppliers documentation.

* Process Improvement: Identify GAPs in the Quality documentation and propose fixes and improvements.
* Data-Driven Quality Engineering:

+ Develop and automate quality dashboards to track Supplier DPPM, Yield, and Cost of Poor Quality (CoPQ).

* Supplier Audits & Corrective Actions: Conduct on-site process audits and lead the 8D/SCAR process, ensuring suppliers implement data-verified root cause closures.
* Operational Flexibility: Exhibit high flexibility to adapt to shifting roles and schedules to align with Enphase’s global operations.
* Incoming Quality Control (IQC): Oversee the inspection of incoming electronic components (PCBA, magnetic materials) and mechanical parts provided by CM sub-suppliers to ensure they meet specifications.
* Process Verification: Ensure the Supplier is following the approved Control Plan.
* NPI Support: Participate in New Product Introduction (NPI) stages helping SQEs to track the completion of Line Qualification Dashboard, FAI (First Article Inspection) and PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) documentation and assisting in pilot production builds.

**Who you are and What you bring**

* Education: College studies in mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience: 2+ years of experience, preferably Supplier Quality and Data analytics.
* Technical Core:

+ Basic knowledge in Quality Core Tools: APQP, PPAP, MSA, SPC, QCP and FMEA.
+ Strong proficiency in Data Analytics and visualization tools.

* Mindset: Strong analytical mindset, high attention to detail, and the ability to act as a "superuser" or admin for new software tools.
* Standards: Desirable basic knowledge of IPC-A-610 (acceptability of electronic assemblies).
* Environment: Frequently involves a mix of professional office settings, cleanrooms/labs, and active construction or fabrication sites.
* Physical Demands: May require standing for long periods, few times lifting to 35–60 pounds.
* Desired Skills:

+ Exposure to contract manufacturing partnership.
+ Working experience in manufacturing industry and data collection.
+ A clear desire to grow into a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQA) role.

* Work location: Salcomp, Chennai, India (Onsite).
* Travel: Travels to supplier facilities (up to 10-20%).

title: AI Content Marketer
description:
**About CultureMonkey**

CultureMonkey is building HR tech for companies that take people seriously.

We help organisations listen to their people better through employee engagement surveys, lifecycle surveys, pulse surveys, action planning, and people analytics. But the real thing we are building is not just software...

We are helping companies build workplaces where people feel heard, understood, and valued.

We are a fast-growing B2B SaaS company working with mid-market and enterprise customers across geographies. Over a million employees in 150+ countries trust us with something important: the honest voice of how they feel at work.

And the way people find us is changing fast. They do not just Google us anymore. They ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. That shift is exactly where this role comes in.

**About the Role**

* We are looking for an AI Content Marketer who can make CultureMonkey the answer... on Google, and inside every AI engine people now ask first.
* This role sits right between content, SEO, product, and distribution.
* You will write content that HR leaders actually finish. You will make sure it ranks, gets cited, and keeps earning attention long after you hit publish.
* This is not a "write a blog and move on" role.
* This is a role about being remembered.
* You will own how a fast-growing brand gets found, read, and trusted in a search world that AI is rewriting in real time.

**What You Will Do**

* Write content people actually finish. Blogs, case studies, and playbooks that are clear, human, and genuinely useful.
* Write for the answer, not just the algorithm. Content built to rank on Google and get cited by AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
* Use AI as a real part of your workflow, for research, drafting, and scaling, then edit hard so every piece stays accurate, original, and human.
* Run keyword and prompt research in Ahrefs and Search Console to publish content that ranks and holds its place.
* Refresh and re-optimize existing content so top pages keep their rankings as search intent and SERPs shift. Content decay is where organic traffic quietly leaks.
* Build domain authority through internal linking and structured outreach: guest posts, backlinks, and partnerships.
* Distribute with intent across newsletters, LinkedIn, Reddit, and product communities. Right message, right channel, right timing.
* Partner across teams on landing pages, sales and marketing emails, and ad copy, all research-backed.
* Track what matters, from CTR and organic traffic to keyword rankings and visibility in AI answers, and let the data shape the next draft.
* Most importantly... do not just write content that fills a calendar. Write the content that people, and AI, actually trust.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 1 to 2 years in content marketing, content writing, SEO, or a similar role where your writing had to perform, not just publish.
* Someone who writes clearly because they think clearly. Practical, useful, no filler.
* Someone who treats SEO and AI search as strategy, not jargon.
* Someone who uses AI fluently but never blindly. You can tell a sharp draft from generic filler, and you fix the difference.
* Comfort with data. Rankings, CTR, and traffic should tell you what to write next, not intimidate you.
* Strong follow-through. You track open items, hit publish dates, and keep multiple pieces moving without being chased.
* A curious, proactive streak. You would rather test an idea than wait for permission.
* Someone who takes feedback without ego and turns it into sharper work.
* Bonus points if you have played with keyword tools, AI writing tools, or have a portfolio you are proud to show.

**You Will Love This Role If**

* You like writing that actually gets read, not just filed away.
* You enjoy turning a messy topic into a clean, useful piece.
* You get a quiet thrill from watching a page climb the rankings.
* You want to crack how to get cited by ChatGPT and Perplexity, not just Google.
* You like data pointing you to your next move.
* You want your work to have visible impact quickly.
* You enjoy working with people who move fast, care deeply, and still know how to have fun.

**Why Join CultureMonkey**

* You will work on content that genuinely matters to the people reading it.
* You will help companies listen to their employees better, not just push another dashboard.
* You will join a content practice that is still being shaped, so your ideas on process, tooling, and how we win AI search will actually matter.
* You will work directly with a fast-moving team that values sharp thinking, ownership, and honesty over hierarchy.
* You will be part of a team that believes people grow when they are trusted, heard, and given room to contribute.
* We practice what we build for customers: people-first experiences, high ownership, empathy, flexible work, learning, fun, and a real sense of belonging.
* Things move fast here. Decisions happen in days, not quarters. Good ideas travel quickly. And when you do good work, you will see its impact almost immediately.

**The Kind of Person We Are Hoping To Meet**

* Someone who is curious about how AI is changing search, and wants to be early to it.
* Someone who can turn a blank page into something people actually want to read.
* Someone who cares about the reader on the other side of the screen, not just the keyword.
* Someone who wants to build a content engine, not just hit publish.
* Someone who believes great content is not about volume, it is about being the answer people trust.

If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

title: Senior Manager, Change Delivery

title: Lead Drive Control Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Systems engineering is a cross-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the users needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation.
  
  
Impacts departmental operations and responsible for planning/execution. The role has some autonomy but is focused on execution of activities within an operating discipline covered by standard functional practices and procedures. Some judgment may be required but this is typically with guidance.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Identify, develop, evaluate, introduce, and manage engineering solutions for product control and control system technology needs. Apply control theory and mathematical modeling to design and control systems with desired behaviors. Includes operability, setting of boundaries, cycle optimization, control logic, control related software, sensors, hardware and software algorithms, and feedback to control the performance of devices, subsystems and systems.
* Developing in-depth knowledge of a technical discipline. Uses prior experience and acquired technical expertise to execute policy/strategy.
* In-depth understanding of key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work. In-depth understanding of how work of own team integrates with other teams and contributes to the area.
* Uses some level of judgment and has ability to propose different solutions outside of set parameters but with guidance. Uses prior experience and on-the-job training to solve straightforward tasks. Has access to technical skills and analytic thinking required to solve problems. May use multiple internal sources outside of own team to arrive at decisions.
* A job at this level is likely to be an individual contributor with proven interpersonal skills or an early people leader who can hire and develop talent. Provides informal guidance to new team members

**Required Qualifications**

* For roles outside of the USA- This role requires advanced experience in the Engineering/Technology & Controls Engineering. Knowledge level is comparable to a Master's / Bachelor's degree in Power electronics and Drives and controls from an accredited university or college ( or a high school diploma with relevant experience).
* Lead project engineer having experience in handling multiple project in power electronics based product development and project execution. This role requires, in addition to closely interacting with internal & external customers, strong inclusive team player with outcome focus & willing to work in Agile methodology of execution

**Desired Characteristics**

* Strong oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.
* Drive control and PWM techniques, MATLAB circuit simulation and Drive control Software, also microcontroller and FPGA based design and development knowledge is preferable.

Experience in software development & qualification for process industry
  
  
Experience with system level validation testing
  
  
Strong technical aptitude, including applicable engineering tools and systems
  
  

* Note:
* To comply with US immigration and other legal requirements, it is necessary to specify the minimum number of years' experience required for any role based within the USA. For roles outside of the USA, to ensure compliance with applicable legislation, the JDs should focus on the substantive level of experience required for the role and a minimum number of years should NOT be used.

**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: Technical Writer
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Content Development

* Contribute to the development of the CCMS structure, templates, and information model.
* Create and maintain Topics, Chaptermaps, Bookmaps, and metadata within the CCMS.
* Demonstrate flexibility in working hours to support collaboration with stakeholders across different time zones, as business needs require.
* Work effectively in a hybrid work environment while maintaining strong communication, collaboration, and accountability.
* Participate in initiatives to enhance documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and content governance.

**Required Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electronics, Aeronautical, Computer Science, or equivalent field).

**Experience**

* 3–6 years of professional experience as a Technical Writer (Senior level) in an international, English-language environment.
* Proven expertise in developing reusable technical documentation using structured or unstructured authoring approaches. Experience with DITA XML and single-sourcing practices is an advantage but not required.
* Basic experience creating technical illustrations in vector or raster formats.
* Experience documenting software, hardware, or custom-engineered solutions, with the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar technologies.

Skills and Competencies
  
  
Core Skills
  
  

* Excellent command of written and spoken English.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.
* Detail-oriented, structured, and dependable in meeting deadlines.
* Effective communicator with global, cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with Simplified Technical English (STE) and style guides such as the Microsoft or Chicago Manual of Style.
* Understanding of DDLC, SDLC, and Agile workflows.
* Knowledge of single sourcing, metadata management, and conditional profiling.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies, understand engineering customizations, and evaluate their impact on the end-user experience.
* Experience reusing and maintaining content from shared repositories while ensuring consistency and accuracy.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Proficiency in authoring MS Word.
* Experience using Microsoft SharePoint or similar content repositories for document management and content reuse.
* Experience with terminology and content quality tools such as Acrolinx.
* Proficiency with illustration tools (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Creo Illustrate, KeyShot).
* Experience with collaboration tools like JIRA and Confluence.
* Understanding of content publishing pipelines and localization workflows.
* Experience with structured authoring concepts is preferred. Familiarity with DITA XML, CCMS platforms (such as Astoria On-Demand or AEM), and XML editors (such as Oxygen XML Editor or Arbortext Editor) is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of XML-based formats and related technologies (XQuery, metadata tagging).
* Interest in GenAI and automation using Python or similar programming languages is desirable.

Assessment Process
  
  

* Candidates will complete a writing and structuring test to demonstrate technical English and content organization skills.
* Successful candidates will advance to subsequent interview rounds with technical and hiring teams.

Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

Position : Project Coordinator – Digital Literacy (Urban)

Location : Chennai

Reports to : State Head

Tenure : 1 Year

HelpAge India is a secular, not-for-profit organisation in India, registered under the Societies’ Registration Act of 1860. Set up in 1978, the organisation works for
*‘the cause and care of disadvantaged older persons to improve their quality of life’*
. It runs healthcare, agecare, livelihood, disaster response and awareness initiatives throughout the country & advocates strongly for the elder cause. It became the first and only Indian organization to be honoured with the ‘UN Population Award 2020’ for its exemplary work in the field of ageing and population issues, and earlier in 2014, has been the recipient of
*‘Vayoshreshtha Samman’*
by Government of India, as an institution working for senior citizens. We have been awarded highest CRISIL VO 1A grading for excellence in operations and high credibility. We have been recognized as a Great Place to Work.

**Role Overview**

The Project Coordinator will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing the Digital & Financial Empowerment Programme for senior citizens across the state. The position requires close engagement with senior citizen associations, community volunteers, community stakeholders, and project teams to ensure effective program delivery, achievement of targets, and timely reporting.

**Programme Implementation & Coordination**

* **Coordinate and oversee programme implementation across designated districts and**
  urban locations.
* Develop and maintain a database of Senior Citizen Associations (SCAs), Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), clubs, elder groups, and urban slum communities.
* Ensure adherence to project timelines, guidelines, and quality standards.
* Monitor programme activities and provide regular updates to the State Program Manager, State Head, and Programme Lead.

**Training & Capacity Building**

* Organize and facilitate monthly digital, financial, and legal literacy workshops for senior citizens.
* Conduct awareness sessions on digital safety, cyber fraud prevention, online services, financial inclusion, and legal rights.
* Train and mentor youth volunteers to support programme implementation.
* Build local resource networks to strengthen outreach and programme impact.

**Monitoring, Reporting & Documentation**

* Ensure achievement of monthly and quarterly programme targets.
* Collect, verify, and maintain programme data for monitoring and evaluation.
* Prepare and submit progress reports, MIS reports, success stories, photographs, videos, and case studies.
* Track participant feedback and recommend improvements to enhance programme effectiveness.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with SCAs, RWAs, elder groups, banks, financial institutions, legal authorities, and community stakeholders.
* Support stakeholder consultations, programme reviews, and planning meetings.
* Represent the programme at local events, networking forums, and observances such as World Elder Abuse Awareness Day (WEAAD) and International Day of Older Persons (IDOP).

**Administrative Support**

* Coordinate logistics for workshops, training programmes, and outreach activities.
* Maintain records of programme activities, attendance, and volunteer engagement.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and project requirements.

Requirements
  
  

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Sociology, Development Studies, Education, Management, or a related field.

* 1 to 3 years of experience in programme coordination, community development, outreach, training, or related social sector projects.
* Experience working with senior citizens, digital literacy, financial inclusion, or community-based programmes will be preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Programme planning and project management
* Training and facilitation skills
* Stakeholder engagement and partnership building
* Monitoring, evaluation, and reporting
* Strong communication and presentation skills, proficency in local language is a must
* MIS and data management
* Problem-solving and decision-making abilities
* Volunteer and team management
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and digital tools

*Disclaimer: The Job Description above is not an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, and responsibilities associated with the position.*

HelpAge India is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without prejudice to caste, religion or belief, sex, gender identity, disability or any other characteristics protected by applicable laws.

HelpAge India is committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity. For more information, visit www.helpageindia.org . Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Interested candidates may apply within 15 days of this advertisement, with a cover /motivation letter, and CV at recruitments@helpageindia.org; along with details of last salary drawn, expected salary, and three professional referees.

Due to the urgency of the position, interviews may be scheduled even before the closure of the advertisement. Hence, interested candidates are encouraged to apply at the earliest. Please note that we will not be able to notify all applicants. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified about the interview date.

title: Manufacturing Process Improvement Engineer
description:
The Process Engineer is responsible for developing or modifying manufacturing processes to increase product performance, improve manufacturing efficiency and boost profits. This position works closely with design engineers, equipment vendors, program managers, marketing, and quality engineers to support the development of new electromechanical products. They are responsible for providing the overall process design and suggesting measures to improve product design for manufacturability. This includes the development of new equipment and process flows as well as developing cost estimates for labor and capital. They will also provide ongoing sustaining support to production lines at our global make sites.
  
  
This role is more focused on process validation, ongoing process development, yield improvement and cost improvement.
  
  
**General Responsibilities**

* Key participant in the development of new production processes and/or adapt existing production processes for assembly, calibration and testing
* Define specifications for production equipment and interact with mechanization (in house) and/or equipment suppliers to ensure equipment will meet specifications
* Key participant in global new product development project teams to enable successful launch of new products
* Collaborate with other departments on process specifications, quality aspects, product specifications and continuity of equipment
* Influence product designs during new product development phase to ensure economical and defect free manufacture
* Developing new or improved manufacturing and testing processes that are necessary to achieve the performance and cost requirements of future device applications
* Organize the arranging of sample lines and process development equipment
* Key participant in advanced quality planning activities
* Coordinates all functional requirements, the reviewing of designs and debugging /qualifying new high volume assembly /test equipment or tooling
* Transferring knowledge to make site personnel
* Support improvement projects to reduce cycle time, defects and manufacturing costs
* Work with suppliers and contract manufacturers to ensure processes are capable, have sufficient controls in place, can meet out delivery requirements, and meet our cost targets
* Evaluate technical capabilities including tooling design, build experience, maintenance program, processes and process controls, cell automation- if required, quality control systems, and material knowledge

**Experience / Qualifications**

* A university degree required (i.e. Bachelors degree) or equivalent relevant work experience
* Must be a team player able to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing tasks and demands
* Strong communication skills; oral, written and presentation
* Strong organization, planning and time management skills to achieve results
* Strong personal and professional ethical values and integrity
* Holds self-accountable to achieving goals and standards
* Proficient in Microsoft Office programs (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel)
* Strong interpersonal & collaboration skills to work effectively with all levels of the organization including suppliers and/or external customers

**Additional Hiring Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech.) in Engineering, Science or another relevant technical discipline.
* Automotive industry experience is mandatory. Candidates with experience only in non-automotive industries will not be considered for this opening.
* Working knowledge of IATF 16949 and automotive manufacturing quality requirements.
* Hands-on experience in manufacturing process validation and process development for mass production.
* Proven experience improving production yield, reducing scrap/process variation and delivering manufacturing cost improvements.
* Familiarity with core manufacturing quality tools and documentation, such as Process Flow, PFMEA, Control Plan, work instructions, SPC and structured problem-solving/8D.

description:

**Problem Management Analyst**
**Role Description Summary**
The Problem Management Analyst is responsible for driving the Problem Management process to improve availability and reliability of Intelsat products, services, and support. The primary objectives include incident prevention and/or minimizing incident impact. The problem analyst maintains information about Known Errors and Workarounds and drives continuous improvement through tracking and driving outcomes from recommendations associated to the register. This position evaluates continuous improvement opportunities to leverage business strategy with system, application, and process integration to support operations.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities / Key Result Areas**

* Schedule and facilitate a formal Post Incident Review or After-Action Review after the resolution of critical and major incidents.
* Perform extensive problem analysis, paying attention to detail of all current and previous problems to identify repeat issues or possible trends.
* Assign and track actions resulting from Post-Incident Reviews and proactive problem investigations, ensuring accountability and timely completion
* Address process and/or training gaps with applicable teams.
* Support the governance and execution of the Problem Management process and Problem Management lifecycle
* Proactively identify problems based on trend analysis from past incidents & monitoring data associated to possible performance deterioration
* Manage and monitor key metrics (SLA’s and KPI’s) from SES and customer perspective as they pertain to Problem Management
* Creates Executive Level Problem Summary and Reports
* Facilitates Problem Management reviews quarterly to review events with no root cause, continuous improvement items and reviews open tasks to determine relevance
* Perform any other functions or duties assigned to ensure workload balance and support
* Work with operational teams for chronic issues associated outages, bugs, network and service design issues, hardware, and software problems
* Drive processes that enable identification of chronic issues and establish expectations for resolution and prevention of recurring incidents
* Drive future solutions for continuous process improvement, design changes, vendor recommendations, automation capabilities, and process improvement opportunities
* Drive processes, methods and techniques for identifying problems and solutions.
* Update and/or archive Knowledge articles associated to the event or workarounds established.
* Provide weekly status report of all items determined to be chronic along with steps taken and next steps to bring resolution.
* Work on problems of diverse scope (low complexity to high complexity) where analysis of recurring issues requires evaluation of multiple operational, technical, and process-related factors

competencies
  
  

* Communication Skills: Strong communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex information to Senior Leadership
* Adaptability: Able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while managing competing priorities.
* Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to identify operational or procedural gaps and challenges; develop innovative solutions to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in the work environment.
* Project Management: Strong organizational skills to lead and coordinate multiple problem investigations, corrective actions, and service improvement initiatives across multiple teams.
* Decisiveness: Ability to lead initiatives and make sound decisions backed by data with little to no supervision.

**Required**
Qualifications & Experience
  
  

* 3 plus years of technical support experience in the satellite or wireless communications industry
* ITIL Certification or demonstrated equivalent experience with event, incident, change, problem and knowledge management processes.
* Practical knowledge of Change Management and Incident Management processes
* Microsoft Applications Proficiency (Access, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Visio, Word)
* Must have strong written and verbal communication skills, be able to work independently as well as part of a team

title: Engineer, Product Applications
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Broadband Plasma (BBP) division is the market-leading optical inspection system used by logic, foundry, and memory customers to detect critical defects at advanced nodes. These tools combine broadband plasma technology with unmatched sensitivity and speed to support high-volume manufacturing.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Application Development Engineer**
**Responsibilities:**

* Customer support: Product value demonstration during beta testing, Head-to-Heads (H2H) and tools in the ramp phase, thereby enabling product penetration/adoption at world-wide customers. This includes-investigating semiconductor manufacturing yield issues and providing inspection solutions; creating & sharing product value statements and use-cases with engineering, marketing and sales groups; training customers and other applications engineers.

title: Engineer - Controls Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Systems engineering is a cross-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the users needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation.
  
  
Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team. Executes standard operational/technical tasks typically subject to instructions and work routines. There is latitude to rearrange the sequence to complete task/duties based on changing work situations.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Conducts component and product integration. All activities that span multiple components and products and are concerned with how to integrate for maximum performance and operability. Manages product and systems requirements, specifications and flow down. Drives validation and verification activities for the overall product/system, including system level testing. Responsible for defining product requirements for the module / component / subcontractors and partners teams. Manages interface between components and execution organizations. Responsible for driving CTQ / Risk trades within the teams designing the components. Manages the overall product configuration and configuration control system.
* Broadening knowledge of own technical discipline to execute policy/strategy. May include support roles with specialized technical field of knowledge; still acquiring higher level knowledge and skills.
* Basic understanding of key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work. Good understanding of how work of own team integrates with other teams and contributes to the area.
* May have some autonomy to make decisions within a defined framework. Resolves issues in situations that require good technical knowledge and judgment within established procedures. Consults more senior team members for issues outside of defined instructions/parameters.
* A job at this level requires good interpersonal skills and may be required to lead a junior team. For customer facing roles, develops strong customer relationships and serves as the interface between customer and GE. Explains technical information to others.

**Required Qualifications**

* For roles outside of the USA- This role requires basic experience in the Engineering/Technology & Systems Engineering. Knowledge level is comparable to a Master's/Bachelor's degree in power electronics and drives and controls from an accredited university or college ( or a high school diploma with relevant experience).
* Good understanding of C, C++, Matlab and Simulink and other engineering tools and systems . Ability and willingness to work "hands-on" in test labs and Customer sites

**Desired Characteristics**

* Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.
* Drive control, product development, control design and real time validation

**For roles outside of the USA, to ensure compliance with applicable legislation, the JDs should focus on the substantive level of experience required for the role and a minimum number of years should NOT be used.**

title: Systems Control Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.
  
  
Beeinflusst den Abteilungsbetrieb und ist verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung.Die Rolle hat eine gewisse Autonomie, konzentriert sich jedoch auf die Ausführung von Aktivitäten innerhalb einer operativen Disziplin, die durch funktionale Standardpraktiken und -verfahren abgedeckt wird.Möglicherweise ist ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen erforderlich, dies erfolgt jedoch in der Regel unter Anleitung.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**

* Führt Komponenten- und Produktintegration durch. Alle Aktivitäten, die mehrere Komponenten und Produkte umfassen und sich mit der Integration für maximale Leistung und Bedienbarkeit befassen. Verwaltet Produkt- und Systemanforderungen, Spezifikationen und den Datenfluss. Führt Validierungs- und Verifizierungsaktivitäten für das gesamte Produkt/System durch, einschließlich Tests auf Systemebene. Verantwortlich für die Definition der Produktanforderungen für das Modul/die Komponente/Subunternehmer und Partnerteams. Verwaltet die Schnittstelle zwischen Komponenten und Ausführungsorganisationen. Verantwortlich für das Vorantreiben von CTQ/Risk-Trades innerhalb der Teams, die die Komponenten entwerfen. Verwaltet die Gesamtproduktkonfiguration und das Konfigurationssteuerungssystem.
* Vertiefung der Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und erworbenes technisches Fachwissen, um Richtlinien/Strategien umzusetzen.
* Fundiertes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Vertiefte Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Verwendet ein gewisses Maß an Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, aber mit Anleitung.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und die Ausbildung am Arbeitsplatz, um einfache Aufgaben zu lösen.Hat Zugriff auf die technischen Fähigkeiten und das analytische Denken, die zur Lösung von Problemen erforderlich sind.Kann mehrere interne Quellen außerhalb des eigenen Teams verwenden, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.
* Eine Stelle auf dieser Ebene ist wahrscheinlich ein einzelner Mitarbeiter mit nachgewiesenen zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten oder Führungsnachwuchs, der Talente einstellen und entwickeln kann.Bietet informelle Anleitung für neue Teammitglieder

**Grundqualifikationen**

* Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung).

**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**

* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

title: Product Analyst
description:
* Release and catalog service parts in support of inquiry resolution globally for all North America programs
* Analyze Engineering systems, 2D Technical drawings, Teamcenter data, Bill of Material (BOM), Marketing information & other reference data and material to determine the appropriate service part levels required for vehicle repair.
* Analyze current and past model engineering changes to determine service interchangeability between engineered parts.
* Prepare and maintain parts catalogue information, as well as creating new catalogue sections, in the Parts Catalogue Database
* Ensure that all the relevant part information is included in the Catalogue database to support VIN matching in the Parts Catalogue
* Modify and create parts catalogue illustrations in line with established processes whilst ensuring that the artwork specifications are met.
* Provide timely resolution to Dealers, Global teams and Internal Customers inquiries regarding issues related to commodities within your sections of the catalog.
* Support service part needs with Engineering, Service operations and upstream activities to address level of service concerns and to ensure service requirements are corrected.
* Support downstream processes like Purchasing, Supply Chain, Packaging, Quality and Distribution to ensure best in class parts availability in support of customer needs.
* Responsible for delivering departmental objectives related to service part releasing, cataloging and customer inquiries.
* Analyst would Monitor the parts within the work queue and determine, based on vehicle program and Job #1 date, the parts that need to be actioned.
* Analyst would use the information on the SBOM to select the part and review its contents and make the decision to release for service - based on historic release information and/or engineering direction and timing.
* Analyst would collect/gather all available information about the parts and review the Engineering direction and production timing as it pertains to that part.
* Analyst reviews the content and format for the text page of the Catalog and makes the necessary changes to the contents whether in the description, model year or restriction fields, as required to fully provide service part information to the users of the Catalog.
* Analyst should update the usage and application for parts requiring corrections.
* Analyst must ensure all the callouts in the illustrations are matches exactly to text before signoff or approving request.
* Analyst should verify the contents of inquiry or concern with text and/or illustrations by using tools and systems to resolve the external and internal inquires.
* Analyst must resolve catalog inquiries and ensure necessary corrections to catalog / illustrations are completed.

**NOTE : PLEASE APPLY WITH EXTERNAL PROFILE ONLY**
Candidate should have BE / B.Tech degree with 2-4 years of experience in Automotive companies, OEM, Dealer ship or Aftermarket parts
  
  
Ability to read 2D Technical drawings & CAD data
  
  
In depth knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint & Access. Alteryx/QlikView/Power BI a plus
  
  
Must be detail oriented, a self-starter with an ability to multi-task and adhere to established deadlines
  
  
Excellent oral and written communication skills
  
  
Goal oriented individual with the ability to interpret data, evaluate actions, and reach logical conclusions.
  
  
Candidate should be willing to work late evening shift (Start: 02:00 PM to 11:30 PM)
  
  
Hybrid work schedule, 4 days’ Work from Office and 1 day Work from Home.

description:
**Description**
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
* Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
* Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
* Analyze data trends and develop solutions
* Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
* Create and maintain quality metrics reports
* Handle customer escalations and recommendations
* Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools
* Support process documentation and implementation

A day in the life
  
  
Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows — reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams.
  
  
Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams).
  
  
You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.
