title: Catalog Manager
description:
**Job Summary** 




 The Catalogue Executive is responsible for managing the organization's product catalogue across all categories, ensuring every product is accurately represented in catalogues, quotation tools, and internal systems. The role focuses on catalogue accuracy, product data management, new product launches, SKU management, pricing updates, and supporting seamless collaboration between Category, Procurement, Design, Sales, Operations, and Technology teams. The objective is to maintain ascalable, standardized, and error\-free catalogue that enables excellent customer experience and
 



 efficient business operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Catalogue Management:** 



* Manage and maintain the master product catalogue, ensuring all product information is accurate, standardized, and up to date across all cities and platforms.
* Create, modify, and archive product records, ensuring discontinued products are removed and new products are added as per approved timelines.
* Maintain a consistent category hierarchy, product groupings, and catalogue version control.



  





**2\. Product Data Management:** 



* Ensure complete and accurate product information, including specifications, dimensions, finishes, materials, warranties, images, and descriptions.
* Validate product data received from vendors and internal stakeholders before publishing it in the catalogue
* Maintain data consistency across catalogues, quotation tools, and other business systems.



  





**3\. Pricing Management:** 



* Update product pricing, discounts, and commercial information based on approved price revisions from the Category and Procurement teams.
* Verify pricing accuracy before releasing updates to ensure error\-free quotations and customer proposals.
* Maintain historical pricing records and support periodic price revisions.



  





**4\. Product Launch Management:** 



* Coordinate the end\-to end catalogue readiness for new product launches, ensuring all product information, images, pricing, and documentation are available.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to ensure products are launched within committed timelines.
* Support the preparation of product launch materials, catalogues, and internal communication.



  





**5\. SKU Management:** 



* Create and maintain unique SKU codes for all products while ensuring there are no duplicate or incorrect entries.
* Update SKU mappings whenever products are modified, discontinued, or introduced.
* Maintain the master SKU database to support inventory, quotation, and reporting systems.



  





**6\. Quote Builder \& System Management:** 



* Coordinate with the Tech team to upload new products, pricing updates, and configuration changes into the Quote Builder and related systems.
* Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate data accuracy before system releases.
* Report and follow up on system issues to ensure minimal disruption to business operations.



  





**7\. Vendor Coordination:** 



* Liaise with vendors to collect product catalogues, images, specifications, pricing, warranty information, and other required documentation.
* Follow up with vendors to ensure timely submission of updated product information.
* Maintain organized records of all vendor documents and communications.



  





**8\. Documentation Management:** 



* Maintain and regularly update product rate cards, technical specifications, installation guidelines, comparison sheets, and other catalogue\-related documents.
* Ensure all documentation follows company standards and version control practices.
* Support the preparation of internal reference documents for Sales, Design, and Operations teams.



  





**9\. Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 



* Collaborate closely with Category, Procurement, Partners to ensure seamless catalogue updates.
* Communicate product changes, launches, and pricing revisions to relevant stakeholders in a timely manner.
* Support cross\-functional initiatives aimed at improving catalogue quality and business efficiency.



  





**10\. Catalogue Quality Control:** 



* Conduct regular audits to verify the accuracy of product information, pricing, images, specifications, and category mappings.
* Identify and resolve catalogue discrepancies before they impact customer quotations or project execution.
* Recommend process improvements to enhance catalogue accuracy, consistency, and operational efficiency.



  





**Educational Qualification:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Data Management or Information Management, or a related field.
* Experience in the Interior Industry is an added advantage.



  





**Experience:** 



* Minimum 2 years of experience in Catalogue Management, Product Management, Procurement Coordination, or Data Management.



  





**SKILLS REQUIRED:** 



* Advanced Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
* Data Validation
* Basic ERP/CRM understanding
* Version Control Behavioural Skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to coordinate effectively with cross\-functional teams and external vendors
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Process\-oriented with a focus on continuous improvement
* Ownership, accountability, and a proactive approach to work
* Adaptability and willingness to learn new systems and processes

title: Program Management Jr Analyst
description:

Good understanding of how the team interacts with others in accomplishing the objectives of the area. Makes evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information. They are expected to resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents. title: Team Lead - Revenue Ops
description:
**Who We Are**
 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
 ****cut carbon****
 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. .
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**Benefits**
* "Remote first" culture \- work anywhere in the continental US as long as you have a reliable internet connection
* Flexible PTO \- no accrued hours and no limit on the number of vacation days exempt employees can take each year
* 11 annual holidays
* 10 days sick leave
* Up to 2 weeks bereavement leave
* 2 volunteer days off
* 2 professional development days off
* Parental Leave Benefits for ALL parents
* 75\-95% employer cost coverage for medical, dental, and vision benefits for employees and dependents


****Celebrating Diversity and Inclusion****
 Here at Arcadia, we cultivate diversity, celebrate individuality, and believe unique perspectives are key to our collective success in creating a clean energy future. Arcadia is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation by emailing careers@arcadia.com prior to completing your application.
   

  

 What We’re Looking For
   

  

****Years of Experience: 5\-8 Years****
**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Problem Solver: Grasp concepts and workflows, come up with a basic implementation plan and set up dashboard views (Jira/Excel/R/Tableau/SQL/Python) to track the assigned work to completion in a time bound manner
* Risk Identification: Analyse the Pro\-s and Cons of existing workflows, make data driven decisions for prioritization and execution.
* Process: Identify the top 3 major blockers for the team (Pareto), enable the team to solve the problem through upskilling, Goal setting and achieving the same
* Product: Identify major tech glitches in workflow, using QC tools to identify team’s output, give insights to Product team to enable quicker, easier deliveries in Onboarding
* People: Understand Team's capabilities, provide regular constructive feedback via 1:1s, setting KRAs and nurture them to step into new responsibilities; work with peers in other teams to setup processes across departments and workflows
* Leadership: Represent Arcadia in Customer/Atlanta Leadership calls, understand the customer pain points and bridge them using workflow modifications and Change management capabilities; Work with Directors, Be in\-tune with the direction of company's growth, ready to explore new domains and challenges
* Reporting: Ensure KPIs are published and reviewed on a daily, weekly, monthly basis and perform analysis on any behaviours / processes that could impact on data integrity; Improve and drive metrics from X to Y in a planned manner


**What You’ll Do**
* Ensure adherence to existing processes \& setting up appropriate dip sticks
* Facilitate root cause analysis for incident reports and identify continuous improvement opportunities in areas of people, tools, and/or process changes
* Collaborate with customer support teams to provide technical support for Urjanet’s data feed and APIs
* Lead best practices for project management including planning, executing, monitoring, and closure of projects
* Manage a portfolio of customer accounts ranging from enterprise to small scale engagements
* Identify capacity requirements to support monitoring SLAs within customer contracts
* Collaborate with account management team for renewal, expansion and churn prevention activities
* Provide feedback to product management team by identifying key product changes to improve efficiencies and overall customer experience
* Coordinate with Urjanet’s offshore teams to ensure data deliveries are on schedule, meeting quality standards, and SLA\-compliant
* Develop, maintain, \& improve processes surrounding customer acceptance of Urjanet data delivered
* Create/update internal \& external documentation to help support all customer processes
* Support ongoing plan to delegate Atlanta support operations tasks to India as the company grows


**What We’re Looking For**
* Degree graduates in BE/B.Tech, Computer Applications, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, and Commerce
* Background in SaaS company / FinTech / BPO
* \>\= 5 years of professional service with at least 3 years as a Team Lead on papers, solution implementation and/or technical support experience
* Data Proficiency: Handling utility data; Microsoft Office Suite, Software exposure such as JIRA, Tableau, R and Power BI
* Strong knowledge in RCA, KRA and Benchmarking
* Experience in customer account/relationship management, Escalation handling, good communication and articulation skills
* Experience managing large scale projects, ability to adapt to changing work environments and priorities
* Very strong goal orientation, work ethic and sense of personal accountability
* High energy, passion, motivational skills, team building skills and a strong ability to work with minimal direction and guidance
* Individual contributors with team handling experience also can apply
* Experience in Banking \& Financial Services, data aggregation, energy or fintech industry is a plus
* Applicants must be willing and able to work rotating shifts
* Experience working with and/or providing technical support for APIs is a plus

title: Technical Writer – AI Security Platform
description:
**Location:** 
 India, Remote\-First
   

  

**Employment:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Start Date:** 
 February 2027
   

  

**Experience:** 
 4\+ years
   

  

**Language:** 
 Fluent English required
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Cybersecurity / Enterprise SaaS / AI Security
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global enterprise cybersecurity company building a new generation of products to secure
 **AI agents, LLM\-powered applications, and the data they access** 
 .
   

  

 As the AI security platform moves toward general availability, customers, partners, and internal teams need documentation that is
 **accurate, technically rigorous, and easy to act on** 
 .
   

  

 You'll own the documentation ecosystem across product guides, API references, deployment and integration documentation, and release materials, working closely with
 **Go engineers, Product Managers, and Support** 
 .
   

  

 We're looking for a Technical Writer who is comfortable reading code and API specifications, can explain complex security and infrastructure concepts clearly, and uses AI tools to work more efficiently without compromising technical accuracy.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Own end\-user, administrator, and API documentation for the AI security platform, from initial structure through ongoing maintenance.
* Create deployment and integration guides for gateway, endpoint, cloud discovery, and platform components, including code samples and configuration references.
* Write release notes and in\-product help, and maintain documentation standards and style guidelines.
* Work directly with engineers to generate and maintain API documentation from OpenAPI and protobuf definitions, keeping documentation aligned with product releases.
* Review technical examples and documentation for accuracy, consistency, and usability.
* Gather feedback from customers and Support to identify documentation gaps and improve clarity.
* Use AI tools to draft, review, update, and maintain documentation at scale while ensuring all technical content is properly validated.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 4\+ years of technical writing experience for developer\- or administrator\-facing B2B software.
* Ability to read Go, Python, OpenAPI, and protobuf well enough to accurately document APIs, configurations, and code examples.
* Experience with docs\-as\-code workflows, including Markdown, Git, static site generators, and CI\-based publishing.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or related technical concepts, or a demonstrated ability to learn complex technical domains quickly.
* Excellent written English with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Practical experience using AI writing and coding assistants, combined with a rigorous process for reviewing and validating their output.
* Comfortable collaborating with distributed engineering and product teams across time zones.
* Strong ownership and attention to technical detail.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience documenting cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, or AI/ML products.
* Experience with API documentation and publishing tools such as Redocly, Stoplight, Docusaurus, or equivalent.
* Basic Python or scripting skills for documentation automation.
* Experience working directly with engineering teams in a docs\-as\-code environment.


 AI\-First Team
   

  

 AI is a core part of how this team works.
   

  

 During the interview process, you'll be asked about how you use AI in your documentation workflow, including the tools you rely on, how you validate their output, and where AI has changed the way you work.
   

  

 We're looking for people who use AI as a
 **force multiplier for research, productivity, problem\-solving, and documentation quality** 
 , while maintaining a high bar for technical accuracy.
   

  

 Why Join
   

  

* Help shape the documentation for a new AI security platform as it moves toward general availability.
* Work directly with engineers, product teams, security researchers, and customers on emerging AI security challenges.
* Own a documentation ecosystem spanning APIs, integrations, deployment, administration, and product education.
* Work on technically complex products at the intersection of cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, and agentic AI.
* Join a highly technical, distributed team where AI is a core part of daily work.


 Pragmatike is committed to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.
   

  

 In accordance with GDPR, your personal data will be processed lawfully, fairly, and securely and used solely for recruitment purposes, including sharing it with our client(s) for employment consideration.

title: Martime Digital Library - Editor
description:
***Company : Evomarine Inc, USA***




***Location : Chennai***




***Work Type : Contract***




***Position : Maritime Digital Library Content Editor***




  





  





  





**1\. Technical Knowledge Library** 




  





 This to create a centralized technical library that will become the knowledge base used by the
 



  





 The documents themselves should be stored in a controlled company repository, preferably Microsoft SharePoint, with proper permissions, revision control and document ownership.
 



  





 I propose the following main folders:
 



  





 \* IMO / International Maritime Regulations
 



   \* SOLAS
 



   \* MARPOL
 



   \* relevant IMO Codes and circulars
 



   \* fire safety requirements
 



   \* lifesaving requirements
 



   \* pollution prevention requirements
 



 \* Classification Society Rules
 



   \* ABS
 



   \* DNV
 



   \* Lloyd’s Register
 



   \* Bureau Veritas
 



   \* IACS Unified Requirements / Unified Interpretations
 



 \* U.S. Navy / NAVSEA
 



   \* NAVSEA Standard Items
 



   \* JFMM requirements
 



   \* applicable NAVSEA technical manuals
 



   \* MIL\-SPEC
 



   \* MIL\-STD
 



   \* Qualified Products / approved material requirements where applicable
 



   \* welding, NDT, piping, electrical, coatings and preservation requirements
 



 \* MARAD / U.S. Government Maritime
 



   \* applicable MARAD vessel specifications
 



   \* USCG requirements
 



   \* 46 CFR requirements
 



   \* vessel\-specific technical specifications
 



   \* ABS requirements applicable to government vessels
 



   \* contract\-specific requirements
 



 \* Engineering Standards
 



   \* ASME
 



   \* ASTM
 



   \* AWS
 



   \* ISO
 



   \* IEC
 



   \* IEEE
 



   \* NFPA
 



   \* API standards where relevant
 



   \* NACE / AMPP where relevant for corrosion and coatings
 



 \* Manufacturer Technical Documentation
 



   \* valve manufacturers
 



   \* pump manufacturers
 



   \* HVAC manufacturers
 



   \* electrical equipment
 



   \* automation
 



   \* piping systems
 



   \* GRE/GRP
 



   \* steel
 



   \* cables
 



   \* switchboards
 



   \* sensors
 



   \* motors
 



   \* heat exchangers
 



   \* filters
 



   \* sewage systems
 



   \* BWTS
 



   \* scrubber equipment
 



   \* etc.
 



 \* EvoMarine Internal Knowledge
 



   \* previously approved BOMs
 



   \* previous RFQs
 



   \* successful suppliers
 



   \* approved technical submittals
 



   \* previous material substitutions
 



   \* lessons learned
 



   \* NCRs
 



   \* commissioning issues
 



   \* preferred manufacturers
 



   \* historic pricing
 



   \* delivery performance
 



   \* supplier ratings
 



   \* technical clarifications from previous projects
 



  





 All standards and controlled documents must be obtained legally from the official publisher, classification society or approved subscription service.
 



  





 We should not build the system around uncontrolled PDF copies from the internet.
 



  





**2\. Technical Requirement Matrices** 




  





 Uploading standards is not enough.
 



  





 We need to convert engineering knowledge into structured rules.
 



  





 For every major material category, we should create a Technical Requirement Matrix.
 



  





 For example, for a valve, the system should know that “3\-inch valve” is not enough information.
 



  





 Before procurement can proceed, it should check for information such as:
 



  





 \* valve type
 



 \* nominal diameter
 



 \* pressure rating
 



 \* design pressure
 



 \* operating pressure
 



 \* design temperature
 



 \* operating temperature
 



 \* fluid/service
 



 \* material of body
 



 \* trim material
 



 \* seat material
 



 \* end connection
 



 \* flange standard
 



 \* actuator/manual operation
 



 \* fail\-open/fail\-close requirement
 



 \* fire\-safe requirement
 



 \* class approval
 



 \* marine approval
 



 \* testing requirements
 



 \* certification requirement
 



 \* applicable standard
 



 \* quantity
 



 \* delivery location
 



 \* required delivery date
 



  





 If mandatory fields are missing, the AI should automatically return questions to the Project Manager or Engineer.
 



  





 The same approach should be developed for:
 



  





 \* pipes
 



 \* fittings
 



 \* flanges
 



 \* valves
 



 \* pumps
 



 \* motors
 



 \* cables
 



 \* electrical equipment
 



 \* instrumentation
 



 \* HVAC
 



 \* heat exchangers
 



 \* structural steel
 



 \* welding consumables
 



 \* insulation
 



 \* coatings
 



 \* GRE/GRP
 



 \* machinery
 



 \* automation components
 



  





 Each technical family should have its own checklist.
 



  





**3\. Hierarchy of Technical Requirements** 




  





 The system must understand that not every project follows the same standards.
 



  





 The applicable rules should depend on the project.
 



  





 For example:
 



  





 Commercial / Cruise vessel:
 



  





 Contract / Client Specification
 



 → Classification Society
 



 → IMO/SOLAS/MARPOL
 



 → Engineering Standard
 



 → Manufacturer Requirement
 



  





 U.S. Navy project:
 



  





 Contract / SOW
 



 → NAVSEA requirements
 



 → NAVSEA Standard Items / JFMM / applicable MIL\-SPEC
 



 → ABS or other class requirements if applicable
 



 → engineering standards
 



 → manufacturer requirements
 



  





 MARAD project:
 



  





 Contract / Vessel Specification
 



 → MARAD / USCG requirements
 



 → 46 CFR
 



 → ABS/class
 



 → applicable engineering standards.
 



  





 The AI must never assume that one standard automatically overrides another.
 



  





 The hierarchy must be configured by project.
 



  





  





 Qualification :
 



 M. Tech in marine Engineering
 



 Must have Sailing Experience or Working knowledge of the Maritime Laws and Codes and Standards

title: Aviation Consultant
description:
**IMPLEMENTATION CONSULTANT, FUNCTIONAL** 




  





**No. of Positions: 2** 




**Nature of Job: Permanent work from home and Contractual based** 




  





**About the Company:** 




 We are a leading technology company passionate about software development for a broad scope of markets, including Aviation, Oil\&Gas and Asset Management. The aim of our software is to boost the productivity of our customers via digital work instructions, starting from Task Planning to Task Execution of front\-line workers.
 



  





 With our product, an open Cloud, Mobile and Wearable platform, we create innovative software solutions, providing technological and analytical services. Our advanced technology (Integration of ATA2200/iSpec2200/S1000D) in Aircraft Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul contributed to our strong international growth and establishing collaborations with the biggest aircraft maintenance companies all over the world.
 



  





 We are looking for Two Aviation Engineers to support digitization of aircraft maintenance work instructions according to the specifications of our customers.
 



  





**Your main responsibilities:** 



* Understand our customer processes and help optimize their work using our high\-tech solutions

title: Senior Telecom Engineer

**Job Description**

 The Senior Telecom Engineer uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Telecommunications discipline within McDermott. The Senior Telecom Engineer solves complex problems and uses their discipline\-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. **Responsibilities**
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**
* Perform conceptual, FEED, studies and detailed analyses and design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards related to Telecom systems
* Apply knowledge and skills to a wide range of standard and non\-standard situations
* Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and procedures
* Manage own time to meet agreed deadlines and budgets and develop plans for short\-term work activities in own area
* Clearly communicate and explain complex issues and work to establish understanding
* Be fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter\-discipline requirements; including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address the issues
* Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates, providing similar support for Variation Orders
* Interface with all disciplines to develop clash free designs
* Interface with other departments to obtain input for Discipline designs and drawings
* Maintain close coordination with other engineering disciplines, Planning, Fabrication, and Project Management Team, as required
* Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to the Discipline Lead Engineer and Discipline Manager
* Assist in the preparation of estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements and manhour estimates
* Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and to maintain preferred McDermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements
* Prepare Discipline engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications, as required
* Participate in finalizing deliverables lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity
* Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required
* Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Telecom Engineering
* Prepare and review design reports and procedures
* Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables
* Assist procurement personnel in procuring Discipline equipment, materials, and services; ensuring that work produced complies with Customer objectives and procedures; procurement assistance includes preparing and reviewing requisitions, evaluating technical quotations and preparing queries, compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, preparing purchase requisitions, and coordinating with Procurement to expedite vendor documents, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer
* Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information
* Check engineering performed by others within the Discipline
* Review vendor and subcontractor submittals, checking for compliance with project specifications and providing comments as necessary
* Perform design verification through single\-discipline check/inter\-discipline check (IDC)
* Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defects/rectification requirements
* Keep the Lead Engineer apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary and manpower related
* Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
* Check final subcontractor and vendor data manuals to ensure that all requested data has been received and approved
* Participate in internal, Customer, and third\-party technical audits on engineering deliverables and vendor documents
* Assist Lead Engineer with responses to Customer and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
* Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR's Lessons Learned system
* Act as а resource for colleagues with less experience
* Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, design calculations, software, requisitions, technical bid evaluations, technical queries, etc.
* Be aware of costs related to own work and of the discipline
* Prepare/review Telecom systems definition, including philosophy, specifications, safety drawings, and system architecture
* Prepare/review FDS\&GDS logic (as applicable)/cause \& effect diagrams (in cooperation with Instrumentation Engineering)
* Prepare/update/review specifications and data sheets for Telecom equipment
* Prepare/review Telecom equipment spare parts lists
* Prepare/review inputs to P\&ID (HSE Process Part especially) development and markups based on receipt of vendor information, Review Telecom equipment testing procedures
* Attend Telecom equipment FAT’s, as required
* Assist in close out of HAZOP action items if applicable
* Gain deep knowledge of Telecom related systems (FDS, GDS, CCTV, TEL/LAN, Radio Systems (RS), Intercom Systems (IS), Public Address General Alarm Systems (PA\-GA), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) and/or Access Control Systems (ACS), etc.)


 Reports to:
   

  

 Project: Lead Engineer
   

  

 Functional: Supervising Engineer or Engineering Manager
   

  

 Liaise with: AII Engineering disciplines, Fabrication group, Safety Department, Document Control, Procurement Group,
   

  

 Subcontractors and Vendors, and Customers
   

  

 Supervises: Telecom Engineers
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications and Education:**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical, or Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering, Master’s Degree is preferred
* 8\-15 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing detail design
* Strong working knowledge of many design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the content and application of standards, codes, and guidelines as applicable
* Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society
* Knowledge of Functional Safety (HW/SW design acc. IEC 61508, Functional Safety Analysis, Design and Operation acc. IEC 61511\)


**About Us**
 Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
   

  

 For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

 **technology, education and product development** 
 .

 We are looking for someone who is curious, comfortable learning new topics and able to explain technical concepts in a simple and structured way.
 



  





 You do not need to come in knowing everything. What matters more is your ability to
 **research, understand a topic properly and think about how it can be taught better.**

* Good research ability

* Exposure to technical writing, educational content or curriculum development

**Freshers are strongly encouraged to apply.** 




  





 We are looking for someone who enjoys researching unfamiliar topics, understanding how things work and finding simple ways to explain them.
 



  





 Previous experience in robotics or curriculum development is not mandatory. What matters more is your ability to

 If shortlisted, you will be given a short activity to help us understand how you research, think and explain a technical concept.
 



  





**We are not looking for textbook answers.**

**Drive Customer Success as an Onboarding \& Implementation Specialist – Tekla Structures**
 Are you a seasoned structural engineer with deep expertise in Tekla Structures who thrives on solving complex technical challenges and guiding clients toward operational success?  Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose\-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work.  Trimble's Professional Services team provides the strategic framework, technical onboarding, and implementation rigor that enable engineering and detailing firms to maximize ROI from their software investments across the structural lifecycle.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Great**
 Reporting directly to the Manager of Professional Services, Training \& Onboarding (India), you will serve as the trusted technical advisor for net\-new and existing Tekla Structures accounts across India. You will have full ownership over discovery meetings, workflow customization, and client success roadmaps. Working at the intersection of sales, customer support, and global product development, you will play a central role in conveying real\-world customer feedback directly back to core engineering teams to influence future software capabilities.
   

  

 Key Exciting Responsibilities
   

  

* End\-to\-End Onboarding Execution: Lead full\-lifecycle software onboarding and implementation programs for new and existing clients utilizing Tekla Structures (Steel and Concrete configurations).
* Workflow Discovery \& Problem Solving: Conduct deep\-dive technical discovery sessions to analyze client requirements, troubleshoot output customization challenges, and engineer tailored structural detailing workflows.

* Project Delivery \& Client Tracking: Help clients establish realistic deployment milestones, deliver ongoing technical guidance to protect timelines, and meticulously track project deliverables and engagement logs.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Value Advocacy: Serve as the primary onboarding anchor across Sales, Support, and Product Development teams, while actively presenting the value of Professional Services to prospective clients.


**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Tekla Structures Deep\-Dive Expertise: 4–5 years of direct, hands\-on experience using Tekla Structures across Steel and Concrete modules.
* Domain \& Industry Experience: 6–7 years of hands\-on structural detailing and design experience with strong domain mastery in structural steel and reinforced concrete workflows.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil, Structural, or Mechanical Engineering.
* Communication \& Engagement: Fluent written and spoken English with exceptional interpersonal skills to command credibility across client C\-suites and job\-site engineering teams.
* Independent Execution: Strong diagnostic capability to troubleshoot software issues independently, manage tight schedules, and drive project success with minimal supervision.


**Bonus Points For**
* Multilingual Capability: Fluency in spoken Hindi to engage effectively across diverse regional client bases in India.
* Global Design Codes: Direct experience executing structural detailing projects according to international engineering codes and standards.
* Customer\-Centric Mindset: Highly organized, detail\-oriented approach with an eagerness to learn complementary Trimble software products.


**Logistics**
* Location: Chennai.
* Job Type: Full\-Time.


 Why You'll Love Working With Us
   

  

 At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real\-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
   

  

* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose\-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* Collaborate with like\-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self\-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.


****How to Apply:****
 Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

 At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). title: Hardware Functional Safety (FuSa) Specialist
description:
**Enabling a software\-defined, electrified future.**
 Visteon is a technology company that develops and builds innovative digital cockpit and electrification products at the leading\-edge of the mobility revolution. Founded in 2000, Visteon brings decades of automotive intelligence combined with Silicon Valley speed to apply global insights that help transform the software\-defined vehicle of the future for many of the world’s largest OEMs. The company employs 10,000 employees in 18 countries around the globe. To know more about us click here .
   

  

**Mission of the Role** 
**:** 
 The Functional Safety Specialist is responsible for ensuring that automotive electronic systems comply with ISO 26262 and related safety standards. The role involves safety concept creation, hazard analysis, safety requirements engineering, technical safety architecture, verification planning, and supporting hardware/software teams through the full safety lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Functional Safety Lifecycle Management
* Lead and execute activities across the ISO 26262 V\-model safety lifecycle, from concept phase to SOP.
* Develop and maintain the Functional Safety Plan, timelines, and work products.
* Ensure processes are followed and all safety artifacts are created and reviewed.
* Safety Analysis \& Concept Development
* Perform Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) and derive ASIL levels.
* Develop Functional Safety Concept (FSC) and Technical Safety Concept (TSC).
* Define safety goals, safety mechanisms, and safety requirements (FSR/TSR).
* Requirements Engineering
* Write, review, and maintain functional and technical safety requirements.
* Ensure bi\-directional traceability between requirements, design, implementation, and validation.
* Support system, hardware, and software teams to interpret and implement safety requirements.
* Hardware \& Software Safety
* Collaborate with hardware architects to define safety mechanisms for MCU, PMIC, watchdog, self\-tests, power domains, fault handling, etc.
* Support software teams in designing safety\-compliant drivers, boot, diagnostics, and monitoring logic.
* Review MCU safety manuals, safety architecture, and vendor documentation (e.g., Infineon Traveo II, NXP, Renesas).
* Safety Analysis \& Verification
* Conduct and review FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA, Dependent Failure Analysis.
* Calculate FIT rates, single\-point fault metrics, and latent fault metrics.
* Create safety validation plans and support unit/integration/system\-level testing.
* Audits, Assessments \& Compliance
* Prepare safety case documentation for customer and auditor reviews.
* Work with internal/external assessors (TÜV, Exida, OEM auditors).
* Support ASPICE, cybersecurity (ISO 21434\), and quality\-compliance alignment.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Provide training and guidance to development teams on ISO 26262 processes.
* Work directly with system architects, hardware designers, software teams, testing, quality, cybersecurity, and program management.
* Participate in design reviews and ensure safety considerations are incorporated early.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
**Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of ISO 26262 Part 2–12 and full safety lifecycle.
* Expertise in safety analyses: FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA.
* Understanding of safety architecture for MCUs, SoCs, and automotive ECUs.
* Experience with safety mechanisms: lockstep CPUs, watchdogs, ECC, BIST/MBIST, CRC, voltage monitoring, clock monitoring, safe states, etc.
* Experience with requirements management tools: DOORS, Polarion, Jama, etc.
* Working knowledge of embedded systems, microcontrollers, hardware design, and automotive software development.


**Domain Knowledge**
* Automotive electronics: clusters, body control, powertrain, ADAS, infotainment, or battery systems.
* Exposure to ASPICE, ISO 21434 (Cybersecurity), and OEM\-specific safety processes.
* Experience
* 5–15 years of experience in automotive embedded systems.
* Minimum 5\+ years in Functional Safety roles.
* Experience delivering at least one safety\-critical product to SOP.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Certified Functional Safety Engineer/Professional (TÜV, Exida).
* Experience with safety implementation on MCUs like Infineon Traveo II, NXP S32, Renesas R\-Car, TI Hercules.
* Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Embedded Systems, or related engineering field.
* Experience with model\-based development (MATLAB/Simulink).


**Visteon Culture:** 
 If you thrive in a fast\-paced, organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability, and a growth mindset from its employees to thrive and stay ahead of the curve Visteon is the place. We value high performance and a drive for results. Innovation, risk\-taking, and continuous learning help us keep up with the ever\-changing landscape of our industry and be Market leaders. At Visteon you can be more.

description:

 Join our team if you Champion People, want to Grow with Purpose through acting with integrity and if you embody the meaning of Be Alight.
   

  

 Learn more at careers.alight.com
   

  

 Job Title
   

  

 Health Benefits Process Trainer
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Develop and deliver expert\-led training programs on health benefits platforms and processes, ensuring internal teams and clients can effectively administer, enroll, and engage with health benefits.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Assist in the planning and execution of learning and development initiatives for new hires within the Health business, across all role levels.
* Conduct needs assessments by collaborating with HR, Benefits Operations, and client teams to identify training gaps and requirements.
* Coordinate logistics for training sessions, including scheduling, room bookings, materials preparation, and communications.
* Design, develop, and update training materials such as facilitator guides, presentations, e\-learning modules, and job aids, in collaboration with subject matter experts.
* Deliver training through classroom, virtual instructor\-led sessions, and self\-paced online modules, for both internal staff and client users on health benefits platforms, analytics tools, workflows, and compliance protocols.
* Maintain and update training records, reports, and documentation using Learning Management Systems (LMS) or other internal tools.
* Track and analyze feedback from training sessions (quizzes, surveys, on\-the\-job performance) and continually evaluate effectiveness to identify areas for improvement.
* Partner with internal teams and external vendors to organize ongoing learning programs, webinars, and workshops.
* Help drive engagement in learning initiatives by creating awareness and communication campaigns.
* Ensure all learning and development activities align with organizational goals and compliance requirements.
* Serve as a subject\-matter expert (SME) during benefits enrollment periods and as a product trainer for new platform features.
* Coach end\-users and project teams on best practices, supporting knowledge transition.
* Analyze results, learnings, and feedback to iterate and enhance training programs.
* Maintain training records, generate reports, and track KPIs via LMS tools.


 Duties \& Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and prepare training curriculum and aids on an ongoing basis for team associates.
* Deliver refresher training modules to targeted associates, based on training needs identified through quality audits.
* Collaborate with Operations and Quality leaders to reduce errors and enhance productivity.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s or Associate’s degree in Human Resources, Education, Business, Psychology, Communications, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience as a trainer in healthcare benefits or benefits administration, with at least 6 years of total work experience.
* Strong understanding of health benefits processes (enrollment, eligibility, compliance, carrier coordination).
* Proficiency with learning technologies, e\-learning development tools, and LMS platforms.
* Excellent facilitation skills for virtual and in\-person delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to design instructional materials using adult learning principles.
* Strong stakeholder management, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Analytical mindset with experience tracking and reporting training metrics.
* Familiarity with Alight Worklife® platform features and benefits analytics is a plus.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Experience working in a corporate or multinational environment.
* Certification in training, facilitation, or instructional design is desirable.


 Ideal Traits
   

  

* Passion for learning and coaching others.
* Ability to adapt to evolving platform features and regulatory changes.
* Detail\-oriented, organized, and experienced in project coordination.
* Comfortable working in a client\-centric, global HR services environment.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.


 This is a Work From Office role requiring individual to be working 5 days a week from the office.

 We offer programs and plans for a healthy mind, body, wallet and life because it’s important our benefits care for the whole person. Options include a variety of health coverage options, wellbeing and support programs, retirement, vacation and sick leave, maternity, paternity \& adoption leave, continuing education and training as well as several voluntary benefit options.

You will be notified during the hiring process which checks are required by the position.

 We celebrate differences and believe in fostering an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. We know that diverse teams are stronger, more innovative, and more successful.
   

  

 At Alight, we welcome and embrace all individuals, regardless of their background, and are dedicated to creating a culture that enables every employee to thrive. Join us in building a brighter, more inclusive future.
   

  

 As part of this commitment, Alight will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact alightcareers@alight.com.

**Product Analyst – Job Description**
**Job Summary**
 The Business Analyst cum Product Analyst analyzes business systems, processes, and data to engineer solutions that enhance business capabilities and operational efficiency. As a core member of the product team, this role translates business workflows into clear technical requirements, specifications, and acceptance criteria. The analyst also functions as a proxy product owner and subject matter expert, collaborating closely with business stakeholders and technical teams. A strong foundation in requirements engineering, process modeling, Agile practices, and data analysis is essential.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Requirements \& Product Analysis**
* Translate business processes, goals, and terminology into technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Act as a proxy product owner for designated business domains, offering functional expertise and guidance.
* Collaborate with product owners, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to analyze, document, and refine product requirements.
* Manage and prioritize product backlog items in Azure DevOps based on business value, dependencies, and stakeholder inputs.
* Prepare communications, presentations, and documentation on system enhancements, alternatives, and recommended solutions.


**Process \& Data Analysis**
* Analyze business workflows to identify opportunities for process improvement, efficiency gains, and automation.
* Validate, interpret, and analyze data from Mainframe environments, DB2 databases, and SQL queries to support decision\-making.
* Contribute to building business cases by gathering data, identifying issues, and documenting components under senior guidance.


**Agile Delivery \& Project Support**
* Support Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Develop schedules of tasks based on overarching project timelines and keep stakeholders informed on progress.
* Participate in system testing, UAT, and production validation to ensure solution accuracy and quality.
* Work independently on projects of low to moderate complexity and with minimal supervision on more complex initiatives.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Build, maintain, and enhance strong relationships with business partners through active listening, consistent communication, and accountability.
* Understand stakeholder needs and expectations to deliver clear, value\-driven solutions.
* Demonstrate trust, influence, and adaptability to meet evolving business requirements.


**Reporting \& Documentation**
* Create business and functional requirement documents, process flows, guidelines, and technical communication materials.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and metrics using Microsoft Office tools to track product performance and project progress.
* Seek relevant information to ensure clarity and accuracy of technical communication tailored to different audience groups.


**Continuous Improvement \& Strategy Execution**
* Apply an understanding of financial, ROI, and market principles to support strategy development.
* Identify inefficiencies within work processes and apply innovative ideas or established tools to improve outcomes.
* Continuously pursue opportunities for system, workflow, and product improvements.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Proven experience as a Product Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role (5–8 years preferred).
* Strong knowledge of Azure DevOps for managing requirements and product backlogs.
* Experience with Mainframe systems, DB2 databases, SQL, and data validation.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/SAFe) and cross\-functional team collaboration.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio).
* Exposure to PL/SQL, EDI Mapping, enterprise integration, and data flows across legacy and modern platforms.
* Core competencies: requirements elicitation, process modeling, workshop facilitation, and analytical thinking.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong stakeholder management ability.
* High attention to detail, strong organizational and time\-management skills, and a problem\-solving mindset.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related discipline.

title: Technician - VAVE
description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** 
 Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry\-leading climate\-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Summary:** 
 The Technician will support the VAVE team by performing product tear\-down activities, collecting and documenting engineering data, preparing analysis reports, and maintaining technical records. The role requires hands\-on disassembly of products, accurate measurement and documentation of components, and collaboration with engineering teams to identify cost reduction and product improvement opportunities.
   

  

**Tear Down Activities**
* Perform systematic tear\-down and disassembly of products, assemblies, and components.
* Identify, classify, and organize parts for further analysis.
* Record component details including material, dimensions, manufacturing process, and part functions.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of teardown components and samples.


**Data Collection \& Analysis Support**
* Collect engineering data from tear\-down activities, drawings, specifications, and BOMs.
* Measure components using standard measuring instruments.
* Capture photographs and maintain detailed records of findings.
* Create and maintain databases of product components, materials, and costs.
* Support benchmarking and competitive product analysis activities.


**Report Preparation**
* Prepare tear\-down reports, data sheets, comparison charts, and presentation materials.
* Document observations, findings, and recommendations in a structured format.
* Generate reports highlighting component details, cost opportunities, and design differences.


**Team Collaboration**
* Work closely with VAVE Engineers, Design Engineers.
* Support engineering reviews and project discussions with collected data and documentation.


**Quality \& Safety**
* Follow laboratory/workshop safety procedures.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and confidentiality of technical data.


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**
 Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics Engineering or related discipline.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 MS Office proficiency, drawing/BOM interpretation, measurement tools knowledge, documentation and analytical skills.
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
 Experience in VAVE, cost reduction, benchmarking, reverse engineering, CAD and PLM systems.
   

  

**Primary Objective**
 Support the VAVE team through product tear\-down, detailed data collection, technical documentation, and report generation to enable cost optimization and product improvement.

**About Two Minute Reports** 




  





 Two Minute Reports is a fast\-growing B2B SaaS platform that helps marketing agencies and businesses automate reporting by connecting data from multiple marketing channels into Google Sheets and Looker Studio. We serve customers worldwide and are focused on building the most efficient reporting solution for marketers and agencies.
 



  





 We are looking for a creative and highly curious
 **YouTube Scriptwriter \& Copywriter** 
 to help us create content that educates, engages, and converts our target audience.
 



 The primary focus of this role will be
 **YouTube scriptwriting** 
 , along with writing copy for email campaigns, LinkedIn, website pages, and other marketing channels.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 As a YouTube Scriptwriter \& Copywriter, you will be responsible for turning ideas, research, customer problems, and industry insights into compelling content.
 



  





 You will create YouTube scripts that capture attention, maintain curiosity, and communicate ideas clearly, while also developing marketing copy that connects with our target audience and drives action.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on role requiring strong research, writing, storytelling, and audience understanding.
 



  





**Key ResponsibilitiesYouTube Scriptwriting** 




  




* Research and develop YouTube topics relevant to marketers, agencies, SaaS companies, and business owners.
* Develop compelling video ideas, hooks, titles, and content angles.
* Write engaging YouTube scripts with strong openings, storytelling, and clear takeaways.
* Turn complex marketing, SaaS, reporting, and business concepts into simple and engaging content.
* Research competitors, industry trends, customer problems, and successful content.
* Use real examples, data, case studies, and customer insights to strengthen scripts.
* Continuously improve scripts based on audience engagement and video performance.
* Repurpose existing content into different formats and content channels.



  





**Copywriting** 




  




* Write email campaigns, sequences, and newsletters.
* Create LinkedIn posts and other social media content.
* Develop compelling headlines, hooks, CTAs, and product messaging.
* Create marketing copy around customer pain points, use cases, and product benefits.
* Support sales and marketing campaigns with persuasive messaging.
* Review and improve existing copy based on performance and feedback.



  





**Research \& Audience Understanding** 




  




* Understand our target audience, including marketing agencies, marketers, and business owners.
* Research customer pain points, challenges, objections, and motivations.
* Understand what makes a prospect pay attention, engage, and take action.
* Translate customer and market insights into better content and messaging.
* Stay updated on trends in SaaS, MarTech, digital marketing, agencies, and content.



  





**Required QualificationsMust Have** 




  




* Strong written and spoken English.
* Excellent storytelling and communication skills.
* Strong research and analytical abilities.
* Ability to write engaging and conversational content.
* Ability to simplify complex ideas and explain them clearly.
* Strong understanding of audience psychology, attention, and persuasion.
* Ability to understand customer pain points and translate them into compelling messaging.
* Ability to write both long\-form content and short\-form copy.
* Strong attention to detail and willingness to iterate based on feedback.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced startup environment.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Experience writing YouTube scripts or video content.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, MarTech, AdTech, analytics, or marketing.
* Experience creating content for marketers, agencies, or business audiences.
* Experience writing emails, sales messaging, or marketing campaigns.
* Experience working with customer\-facing or growth\-oriented teams.
* Understanding of content marketing, conversion copywriting, or marketing funnels.
* Familiarity with AI tools for research, ideation, and content creation.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* Someone who is genuinely curious about
 **why people buy, click, watch, and engage** 
 .
* Someone who can turn a basic idea into a compelling story.
* Someone who understands that good copy is about the audience, not just good grammar.
* Someone who can research a topic deeply and communicate the important parts simply.
* Someone who is comfortable taking feedback and rewriting until the content is strong.
* Someone who thinks about the business objective behind every piece of content.
* Someone who is willing to learn the product, market, and customers deeply.



  





  





**Why Join Two Minute Reports?** 




  




* Opportunity to create content for a growing global B2B SaaS company.
* Work directly with founders and the marketing team.
* Build content that reaches a global audience.
* Opportunity to develop expertise across YouTube, copywriting, SaaS, and marketing.

title: Associate Engineer - Digital & Drw Mgmt
description:
**What’s The Role**
 Technical Asset Support (TAS) is a key enabler for the accelerated delivery of Shell’s Asset Management System and will help us to reach our ultimate potential in Downstream Manufacturing, Integrated Gas and Upstream. TAS provides high quality and cost\-competitive technical resources who are not physically present at site yet are an integral part of asset teams delivering value through end\-to\-end SEAM / AMS work processes.
   

  

 As an Associate Engineer \- Digital \& Drw Mgmt, you will support engineering document and drawing management in the energy industry by reviewing redline markups, updating and quality\-checking technical drawings and documents, and ensuring compliance with document control standards. It requires experience with AVEVA P\&ID, MicroStation, EDMS, and SharePoint, along with the ability to interpret P\&IDs, isometrics, and other engineering drawings, manage metadata, validate data quality, and support intelligent P\&ID conversion and maintenance activities.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Review red line markup (RLM) changes in technical drawings, collaborating with team members, incorporating revisions, and contributing to overall work quality. Work in EDMS (Doc Management tool).
* Proficient in interpreting and understanding corrections, redline markups, and updates across related engineering drawings.
* Proficient in AVEVA P\&ID as an end user with strong practical working experience.
* Ability to read, understand, and interpret P\&IDs, Isometrics, Plot Plans, and General Arrangement (GA) drawings.
* Strong knowledge of AVEVA P\&ID application, including object attributes, relationships, and validation checks.
* Generate and analyze engineering reports, line lists, equipment lists, valve lists, and other project deliverables from the AVEVA P\&ID database.
* Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve AVEVA P\&ID application issues related to drawing connectivity, database attributes, validation errors, and reporting inconsistencies.
* Experience in preparing engineering documentation, drawing evidence, and technical records to support Root Cause Analysis (Why\-Why Analysis) and incident investigations.
* Developed automated workflows and reports to enhance engineering productivity and data integrity.
* Experience working in critical assessment and quality review environments, ensuring high accuracy and compliance.
* Hands\-on experience in conversion projects from non\-intelligent (legacy) to intelligent P\&IDs, including data structuring and tagging.
* Ability to analyze, extract, and interpret reports generated from AVEVA P\&ID for quality control and data validation.
* Good understanding of engineering data consistency, tagging philosophy, and metadata management within P\&ID systems.
* Interpret and validate Process \& Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&IDs) based on process engineering principles, plant operations, and maintenance requirements.
* Identify discrepancies between P\&IDs, PFDs, Isometrics, Cause \& Effect diagrams, and other engineering documents.
* Perform engineering data validation to ensure compliance with asset tagging standards, drawing standards, and engineering best practices.
* Understand process flow, equipment functions, piping systems, control philosophy, and instrumentation represented in P\&IDs.
* Analyze the impact of proposed changes on equipment, piping systems, instrumentation, and associated engineering data.


**What You Bring**
* A graduate engineering degree with 3\+ years of relevant industry standard experience in combination of Process, mechanical, instrumentation \& electrical disciplines.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure during peak workloads and provide flexible support across related processes within team scope.
* Hands\-on experience with AVEVA P\&ID and MicroStation is mandatory.
* Performed data validation, consistency checks, and quality assurance of P\&ID deliverables.
* Support Team Leads with drawing\-related queries and technical support needs, including training site staff on software and request tools, and assisting with pilot tests and demonstrations.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to deliver analytical solutions are essential.
* Strong stakeholder management and time management skills are required.
* Candidates should demonstrate strong learning agility and a growth mindset.
* Excellent communication skills and a quick learner. Be a good team player. Ability to prioritize and ensure delivery of priorities for the area of responsibility. Flexible and adaptable to change, with a track record of demonstrating initiative, analytical capabilities and problem\-solving.
* Ability to apply engineering best practices, codes, and standards to identify issues, recommend improvements, and implement solutions.
* Excellent stakeholder management with business interface exposure
* Strong interpersonal leadership skills are critical due to the requirement for effective communication of complex issues across multiple offices and teams.
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple projects and programs simultaneously.
* Ability to independently, resourcefully, and creatively research and implement new solutions.
* Ability to engage and effectively communicate at all levels inside and outside Shell and within different cultural settings.
* Strong interpersonal skills, ability to challenge and ability to build internal and external relationships based on trust and to integrate across multiple functions.
* Competitive applicants will have a proven track record of delivery in Asset and/or Project.
* While the hubs will remain the core locations for SEAM, we will continue to use a distributed working model. This means that our preference is to appoint the best candidate for the job on local terms working virtually from their base country.
* This role does not require global travel but may require flexibility in working hours to support collaboration across time zones, influence stakeholders, and drive business performance. Such flexibility will be considered with sensitivity to diverse family circumstances.


**What We Offer**
 You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
   

  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values\-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.
